avis.titre: Soft, lightweight & perfect for sensitive skinSoft, lightweight & perfect for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I recently tried the SVR PEPTI Biotic Cream, and for my oily, acne prone, and sensitive skin, it’s turned out to be a very smart pick. The texture is a light gel cream, which feels hydrating but not heavy, perfect for my T zone and overall oily areas. What I really like: it contains sodium acetylated hyaluronate and glycerin, which give good hydration without making my skin slick or congested. The squalane helps soothe without clogging, and the collagen peptide feels like it’s helping smooth my skin’s texture. Plus, there’s a probiotic ferment (lactobacillus), which feels calming to my skin and fits nicely into my routine when I’m trying to maintain my barrier. The ascorbyl tetraisopalmitate (vitamin C derivative) is a gentle brightener, helpful for fading my dark spots without triggering irritation. I do notice a little sweet almond oil in the formula, for some acne prone skin that could be tricky, but here it’s quite low in the list, and I haven’t experienced any new breakouts using it. There is fragrance, so if your skin is super sensitive or in a flare, you might want to patch-test first, but for me it’s fine at this moment. In terms of finish, it doesn't leave a matte look, but I am not oily or dewy, which I appreciate, because I don’t want to add shine. The non comedogenic claim seems legit: my skin has stayed comfortable and clear while using this.
